projects.title: Investigating bodily self-consciousness using virtual reality
projects.summary: Students investigate bodily self-consciousness using virtual reality. The page lists this as one of the lab's currently open student projects.

projects.title: Vestibular contributions to bodily self-consciousness (motion platform)
projects.summary: This project examines how the vestibular system contributes to bodily self-consciousness, using a motion platform. The page lists it as an open student project.

projects.title: Investigating hallucinations in Parkinson's Disease
projects.summary: This project investigates hallucinations in Parkinson's disease. The page lists it as an open student project.

projects.title: Investigating Genomic Data Transformations for Predicting Disease Outcomes using Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develops methods to transform large-scale genotype (SNP) data into compact, biologically meaningful features for disease prediction. The project will also explore transformations based on foundational DNA models such as AlphaGenome, to improve machine learning and deep learning predictions of disease outcomes.

projects.title: Enhancing Cardiovascular Disease Prediction by Integrating Rare Variants into Polygenic Risk Scores
projects.summary: Aims to improve polygenic risk scores (PRS) for cardiovascular disease by integrating rare, high-impact genetic variants alongside common variants, using UK Biobank data. The project includes an optional external validation on the Swiss HIV Cohort Study data.

projects.title: Decoding the spectral diet of humans: Development of new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries data
projects.summary: Develop new analysis methods for spectral light exposure timeseries recorded by a wearable 14-band spectral sensor (Spectrace) used in field studies of personal light exposure. The focus is on unsupervised methods for clustering and classification of the data.

projects.title: Determination of the bioavailability of chemical additives from plastics and tire particles using simulated lung fluid
projects.summary: Study the bioavailability of chemical additives released from plastic and tire particles by testing them in simulated lung fluid. The project is an MSc-level topic offered by GR-CEL.

projects.title: Development of an analytical method based on molecular rotors for the detection of nanoplastics in environmental samples
projects.summary: Develop an analytical method using molecular rotors to detect nanoplastics in environmental samples. The project is an MSc-level topic offered by GR-CEL.

projects.title: Evaluation of the contamination of the lake sediments by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
projects.summary: Evaluate the contamination of lake sediments by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). The project is an MSc-level topic offered by GR-CEL.

projects.title: Assessing the contamination of fishes by micropollutants using non-targeted analysis
projects.summary: Assess micropollutant contamination of fish using non-targeted analysis. The project is an MSc-level topic offered by GR-CEL.

projects.title: Boundary Element simulations for elasto-static
projects.summary: Develop and test a robust, fast 2D and 3D boundary element code for elastostatic problems, possibly with many cracks, and apply it to problems in solid mechanics.

projects.title: Fracture statistics of quasi-brittle rock from CT scan images
projects.summary: Analyse the statistics of fracture traces picked by a deep convolutional network from more than 10,000 microCT images of fractured rock samples, and possibly improve or re-train the network.

projects.title: Distributed fiber optic strain sensing – Inversion for load reconstruction
projects.summary: Combine mechanical experiments with distributed fiber optic strain sensing and inverse modelling to reconstruct the loading that caused a measured strain in a solid of known properties.

projects.title: Fluid driven fault re-activation associated with H2 / CO2 storage
projects.summary: Use finite element modelling of thermo-hydro-mechanical problems to study how pore-pressure and stress changes from subsurface fluid injection or withdrawal can reactivate faults.

projects.title: Fracture thermal energy storage
projects.summary: Study a concept for seasonal heat storage in impermeable strata by engineering fractures and using hydrothermal loading and unloading cycles as a thermal battery, through lab experiments and modelling.

projects.title: Imaging of failures using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Use active and passive acoustic monitoring of quasi-brittle materials such as concrete and rock to image the evolution of damage and failure, applying signal processing, data analysis and seismological methods.

projects.title: Design of a polyaxial frame for rock mechanics testing
projects.summary: Use finite element simulations to design a true triaxial reacting frame for rock testing, including platen and sample friction.

projects.title: Limit analysis for the design of geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Model numerically the soil-structure interaction problem at the ultimate limit state to support geotechnical engineering design. Students must have taken the Computational Geomechanics course.

projects.title: Modelling of the failure of quasi-brittle material
projects.summary: Numerically reproduce novel experiments characterising the fracture mechanics of quasi-brittle materials such as rock and concrete, using distinct element modelling, with the goal of modelling the gap-test used to quantify concrete failure. Carried out in mobility at Georgia Institute of Technology with Prof. H. Huang.

projects.title: Understanding hydromechanical deformations around volanic systems
projects.summary: Investigate the hydromechanical deformations around volcanic systems.

projects.title: Rock slope stability under climate change
projects.summary: Study how climate change affects the stability of rock slopes.

projects.title: Predicting the excavation damage zone of tunnels in quasi-brittle rocks
projects.summary: Predict the excavation damage zone around tunnels excavated in quasi-brittle rocks.

projects.title: Interaction between Shear-banding & re-inforcements in geotechnical engineering
projects.summary: Study the interaction between shear banding and reinforcements in geotechnical engineering.

projects.title: Elastic rebounding due to retreating Glaciers in the Alps
projects.summary: Study the elastic rebound of Alpine bedrock caused by retreating glaciers.

projects.title: Limit analysis for geotechnical engineering ULS design
projects.summary: Apply limit analysis to geotechnical engineering design at the ultimate limit state, using numerical modelling.

projects.title: Modeling the geomechanical response of hydrogen/co2 storage in porous media
projects.summary: Model the geomechanical response of porous media to hydrogen or CO2 storage.

projects.title: Imaging of fracture and defects using active and passive acoustics
projects.summary: Use active and passive acoustic methods to image fractures and defects.

projects.title: Analysis of an in-situ injection experiment at the Bedretto Res. Lab.
projects.summary: Analyse an in-situ fluid injection experiment carried out at the Bedretto Underground Research Laboratory.

projects.title: Revisting the Barbarbunga magmatic intrusion sequence
projects.summary: Revisit the magmatic intrusion sequence of the Bárðarbunga volcanic system.
